title: NMR Extraction Protocol for C. elegans Samples
author: Brianna M Garcia
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2rbqd2n

steps.title: Retrieve frozen samples
steps.instruction: Remove lyophilized C. elegans samples from the –80 °C freezer.

steps.title: Add zirconia beads
steps.instruction: Add approximately 200 µL of 1.0 mm Zirconia beads (BioSpec, Cat. No. 11079110zx) to each sample.

steps.title: Bead‑beat homogenization
steps.instruction: Using a FastPrep‑96™ instrument (MP Biomedicals, model 116010500) equipped with a QuickFlex™ Sample Holder (catalog 116010570), homogenize each sample at 420 rcf for 1 min 30 s; place the tube on dry ice for 1 min 30 s to avoid overheating. Repeat the homogenize‑cool cycle three times.

steps.title: Store post‑homogenization
steps.instruction: Keep the homogenized samples on dry ice, or store at –80 °C until ready to continue.

steps.title: First IPA addition
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 100 % isopropanol (IPA) chilled to –20 °C to each homogenized sample (containing lyophilized worms and beads).

steps.title: Vortex first IPA
steps.instruction: Vortex each sample for 30–60 seconds.

steps.title: Room‑temp incubation 1
steps.instruction: Let the sample sit at room temperature for 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Second IPA addition
steps.instruction: Add an additional 500 µL of 100 % IPA chilled to –20 °C to each sample (now containing lyophilized material, beads, and the first IPA aliquot).

steps.title: Vortex second IPA
steps.instruction: Vortex each sample for 30–60 seconds.

steps.title: Room‑temp incubation 2
steps.instruction: Let the sample sit at room temperature for 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Overnight storage
steps.instruction: Store the samples overnight (≈12 hours) at –20 °C.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples for 30 minutes at 20 800 rcf, 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect non‑polar extract
steps.instruction: Using a Pasteur pipette, transfer the supernatant of each tube to a new 2 mL tube; this fraction will be used for non‑polar molecule analysis.

steps.title: Add methanol‑water
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 80:20 methanol:water (MeOH:H₂O) chilled to 4 °C to each tube containing the remaining worm pellet and beads.

steps.title: Shake polar extract
steps.instruction: Shake the tubes at 4 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 30 minutes at 20 800 rcf, 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect polar extract
steps.instruction: Using a Pasteur pipette, transfer the supernatant to a new 2 mL tube; this fraction will be used for polar molecule analysis.

steps.title: Dry non‑polar extracts
steps.instruction: Place all non‑polar extract tubes in a CentriVap (Labconco, model 7810010) at room temperature and monitor until completely dry.

steps.title: Dry polar extracts
steps.instruction: Place all polar extract tubes in a CentriVap at room temperature and monitor until completely dry.

steps.title: Store remaining pellet
steps.instruction: Store the remaining worm pellet and zirconia beads at –80 °C for future protein or carbohydrate analysis, or discard them appropriately.
